conclusion.basis: Four independent routes (Crossref, OpenAlex by DOI, OpenAlex by year+first-page, Semantic Scholar) plus five controls that all succeed on the same routes in the same session. No route produced any Guyer+McCracken record, and no 1990 PRA article exists at page 6371.
conclusion.what_a_guyer_mccracken_record_would_be: None exists in any index consulted. The real Guyer second-sound papers are with Krumhansl (1964, 1966) and with McClintock and Mueller (1968); 'McCracken' is not associated with any of them.
conclusion.root_cause_of_arena_label: phase5/references/doi_verification.csv marks this row YES/YES/YES, but scripts/validate_references.py only tests DOI syntax, duplicate DOIs and status labels - it never contacts Crossref. The 'Crossref match' column is self-asserted.
